narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I think a tilted square has fewer lines of symmetry than an upright square, because it is turned.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Turn the tilted square on the table until it stands upright. The same four folds still work.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The paper is the same shape, so turning it cannot change the number of lines.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, fold along each line you counted and see if the halves overlap.
<bookmark mark='rule'/>A shape with equal sides and equal angles has as many lines of symmetry as it has sides.
